approved.en: Ukrainian naval drones have repeatedly struck Russian warships at Libya's Benghazi port, including a recent attack that hit a Russian vessel and prompted Zelensky to say Ukraine can attack wherever it wants. In Ukraine, civilian casualties in 2026 are already far higher than in previous years, with a deadly overnight Russian apartment strike killing at least nine people and a blast in central Kyiv injuring several, including a foreign national. Russian forces continue targeting Ukrainian civilian sites, while Ukraine also used drones against a refinery in Novoshakhtinsk. Battle-related deaths totaled 75,767 in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Ukrainske marine-droner har gjentatte ganger truffet russiske krigsskip i havnen i Benghazi i Libya, inkludert et nylig angrep som traff et russisk fartøy og fikk Zelensky til å si at Ukraina kan angripe hvor det vil. I Ukraina er sivile tap i 2026 allerede langt høyere enn i tidligere år, med et dødelig overnattingsangrep fra russiske leiligheter som drepte minst ni personer og en eksplosjon i sentrale Kyiv som såret flere, blant dem en utenlandsk statsborger. Russiske styrker fortsetter å ramme ukrainske sivile mål, mens Ukraina også brukte droner mot et raffineri i Novoshakhtinsk. Dødsfall knyttet til kamper beløp seg til 75 767 i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Settler attacks on Palestinian villages in the West Bank continue, with Israeli officials labeling them as Jewish terrorism and urging police, not the IDF, to intervene. Israeli forces have detained dozens during a raid on a West Bank refugee camp and have been accused of a 350% surge in attacks on medics there. In Gaza, Israeli bombardment has been described as creating a toxic wasteland, cutting off vital hearing-aid supplies and prompting reports of environmental crimes affecting 99% of the enclave. The conflict has resulted in 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Israelske styrker har arrestert dusinvis under et raid på en flyktningleir på Vestbredden og er blitt anklaget for en 350 % økning i angrep på medisinsk personell der. I Gaza har israelsk bombardement blitt beskrevet som å skape et giftig ødeområde, kutte av viktige hørselsapparatforsyninger og føre til rapporter om miljøforbrytelser som påvirker 99 % av enklaven. Konflikten har resultert i 21 440 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Israeli soldiers demolished houses in southern Lebanon and then withdrew, allowing Lebanese villagers to return to damaged homes, while Lebanese President Aoun demanded Israel pull back and warned Iran against interference. An IDF spokesperson visited a Lebanese school, prompting outrage, and the IDF later said sirens in two border communities were false alarms. Israel publicly sent best wishes to Lebanon on its Independence Day, which was observed quietly. The Lebanese army arrested three individuals accused of smuggling explosives from Syria, and the conflict caused 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Iran has struck U.S. bases in Bahrain and set fire to an industrial facility there, and launched missiles into the Strait of Hormuz. An athlete swam the length of the strait to draw attention to the environmental impact of the fighting, while a tracking site reported that a claimed Iranian tanker in the strait does not exist. Iran also unveiled a dual-missile launcher and a new missile city, expanding its missile capabilities. Hakeem Jeffries pledged sanctions on violent West Bank settlers and an end to the Iran war. 123 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

En idrettsutøver svømte hele bredden av stredet for å trekke oppmerksomhet mot miljøpåvirkningen fra kampene, mens et sporingssted rapporterte at en påstått iransk tankskip i stredet ikke eksisterer. Iran har også avduket en dobbelmissilutskyter og en ny missilby, og utvider sine missilkapasiteter. Hakeem Jeffries lovet sanksjoner mot voldelige bosettere på Vestbredden og en slutt på Iran-krigen. 123 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Houthis have stepped up missile and drone attacks on Saudi Arabia, striking the Rabigh refinery and launching missiles toward Riyadh, while the Saudi-led coalition intercepted multiple missiles and a drone in the Red Sea and western Yemen. Saudi forces responded by striking Yemen's Hodeidah port city, killing ten civilians, and the coalition also reported intercepting a missile in the western region. Houthi fighters claimed seizure of large weapons stockpiles in Mokha and warned of further threats to Red Sea shipping. Dozens of children were killed in Yemen amid the intensified fighting, and 918 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Houthiene har økt missil- og droneangrepene mot Saudi-Arabia, har truffet raffineriet i Rabigh og skutt missiler mot Riyadh, mens den saudisk-ledede koalisjonen avskjærte flere missiler og en drone i Rødehavet og i vestlige Jemen. Saudiske styrker svarte med å angripe havnebyen Hodeidah i Jemen, der ti sivile ble drept, og koalisjonen rapporterte også at de avskjærte et missil i den vestlige regionen. Houthi-krigerne hevdet at de hadde tatt kontroll over store våpenlagre i Mokha og advarte om ytterligere trusler mot skipsfarten i Rødehavet. Dusinvis av barn ble drept i Jemen i den opptrappede kampene, og 918 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Security personnel continue to be targeted in Syria, with attacks injuring four guards in Suwayda and a drone strike wounding four more, while a landmine blast in Idlib killed five children. A cluster munition killed a child in southern Syria, and Syrian authorities arrested a church guard and other suspects in a theft at Our Lady of Peace Church in Homs. Lebanon’s army seized 264 kilograms of explosives near the border and Syrian officials intercepted weapons smuggling attempts, reflecting ongoing cross-border illicit activity. Egypt reiterated support for Syria’s unity and sovereignty. 2,732 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Sikkerhetspersonell fortsetter å bli målrettet i Syria, med angrep som såret fire vakter i Suwayda og et droneram som såret fire til, mens en landmineeksplosjon i Idlib drepte fem barn. En klyngeammunisjon drepte et barn i sørlige Syria, og syriske myndigheter arresterte en kirkegard og andre mistenkte i et tyveri på Our Lady of Peace-kirken i Homs. Libanons hær beslagla 264 kilogram eksplosiver nær grensen, og syriske tjenestemenn avbrøt forsøk på våpen smugling, noe som viser pågående grenseoverskridende ulovlig aktivitet. Egypt gjentok sin støtte til Syriens enhet og suverenitet. 2 732 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Iraqi security forces have entered Jurf al-Sakhar, deploying Brigade 72 and establishing checkpoints as Kataib Hezbollah begins a phased withdrawal, while the militia announced its own timetable for leaving. A power-station explosion in Basra killed at least four people and police arrested officers and suspects linked to oil-pipeline smuggling between Dhi Qar and Basra. Senior ISIS leaders were killed in operations in eastern and northeastern Iraq and a new Shiite militia, Asa'ib Al-Jihad, announced its formation. Iran carried out a strike that wounded two people in Bahrain, prompting Saudi condemnation, and the KRG has asked internet providers to block Telegram. The UCDP recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Irakiske sikkerhetsstyrker har gått inn i Jurf al-Sakhar, har satt inn Brigade 72 og opprettet kontrollposter mens Kataib Hezbollah begynner en trinnvis tilbaketrekning, mens militsen kunngjorde sin egen tidsplan for å forlate området. En eksplosjon på en kraftstasjon i Basra drepte minst fire personer, og politiet arresterte tjenestemenn og mistenkte knyttet til smugling av oljerørledninger mellom Dhi Qar og Basra. Seniorledere i IS ble drept i operasjoner i østlige og nordøstlige Irak, og en ny sjiamuslimsk milits, Asa'ib Al-Jihad, kunngjorde sin opprettelse. Iran gjennomførte et angrep som såret to personer i Bahrain, noe som førte til en saudisk fordømmelse, og KRG har bedt internettleverandører om å blokkere Telegram. UCDP registrerte 396 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: RSF drones struck near Khartoum, killing four people and damaging a United Nations building, while separate drone attacks hit a residential area and another UN facility in the capital. The RSF also continued ground offensives, attacking aid offices in Nyala and a shelter in West Kordofan, causing civilian casualties. Charity kitchens in Khartoum are closing, leaving displaced Sudanese, especially the elderly, in severe hardship. The conflict produced 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

RSF fortsatte også bakkekampene, og angrep hjelpekontorer i Nyala og et tilfluktssted i Vest-Kordofan, noe som førte til sivile tap. Veldedige kjøkken i Khartoum stenger, og etterlater fortrengte sudanesere, spesielt eldre, i alvorlig nød. Konflikten førte til 4 680 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Rebel and SPLA-IO forces have intensified attacks across South Sudan, killing civilians in Tonj East, Warrap State, and other locations, with recent incidents reporting 24 deaths including children and women. Cattle-theft raids have also turned lethal, leaving dozens dead and prompting fear of missing persons after assaults on islands such as Miny Island in Jonglei. The violence has spread to the political sphere, with the brother of former Juba Mayor James Allah-Jabu dying and the former vice president Igga announcing the death. The crisis now includes large-scale killings reported in Ruweng and ongoing insecurity ahead of the postponed 2026 election. According to UCDP, there were 2 battle-related deaths in 2024.
approved.nb: Rebel- og SPLA-IO-styrker har økt angrepene over hele Sør-Sudan, og har drept sivile i Tonj East i Warrap-stat og andre steder, med nylige hendelser som rapporterer 24 døde, inkludert barn og kvinner. Kvegtyveri-raider har også blitt dødelige, og har etterlatt dusinvis av døde og skapt frykt for savnede etter angrep på øyer som Miny Island i Jonglei. Voldshandlingene har også nådd den politiske arenaen, da broren til den tidligere Juba-ordføreren James Allah-Jabu er død, og den tidligere visepresidenten Igga kunngjorde dødsfallet. Krisen omfatter nå store drap i Ruweng og vedvarende usikkerhet før det utsatte valget i 2026. Ifølge UCDP var det 2 dødsfall i kamper i 2024.

Simultaneously, clashes on Ethiopia's southern border with Kenya at Moyale have disrupted livelihoods and displaced people, prompting travel warnings and calls for refugee support. In the Amhara region, the Fano insurgency continues to threaten water security in the Nile Basin, adding a new dimension to the Horn of Africa conflict. The conflict caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Somalia has expelled the United Arab Emirates ambassador after accusing Abu Dhabi of converting civilian airfields in Somaliland and Puntland into military bases and funding armed groups that undermine national unity. Federal forces quietly relaunched the previously failed Banooda operation, moving a major troop convoy, while U.S. airstrikes hit al-Shabaab at three locations across the country. The United States reversed its stance, now funding UN military support in Somalia for another year after previously withdrawing that funding. The conflict produced 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Bandits in Zamfara have imposed a N50 million levy on communities and declared no-go zones ahead of the 2027 elections, while gunmen have repeatedly set secondary schools ablaze in Plateau, including a school in Bokkos. In Gombe, Air Force personnel allegedly opened fire on civilians, causing deaths and injuries, and in Benue military forces rescued two abducted women. ISWAP suffered a major loss with a Shura Council member and top commanders killed as troops repelled an attack in Borno. The conflict recorded 1,486 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Gombe skal luftforsvarets personell ha åpnet ild mot sivile, noe som har ført til dødsfall og skader, og i Benue reddet militæret to bortførte kvinner. ISWAP led et stort tap da et medlem av Shura-rådet og toppkommandanter ble drept da tropper avverget et angrep i Borno. Konflikten registrerte 1 486 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

South African mercenaries have been captured in eastern DRC, and Kenya and the DRC presidents have agreed to restore diplomatic ties after a meeting in Brazzaville. 1,158 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: The International Court of Justice ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya, prompting Malaysia to pledge cooperation with the UN, OIC and ASEAN, while the junta accused ASEAN of unfairness in its peace-plan review. In May 2026 a Burma Army air strike in Doo Tha Htoo District killed one villager and injured five, including two children, and destroyed houses in Bilin Township. The junta continues large-scale attacks on Rohingya civilians, including a bridge-destruction campaign in Arakan and the advance of a 108‑kilometre fence on the Bangladesh border. It also admitted corruption in its conscription system and began actions against nearly two hundred officials. There were 2,332 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I mai 2026 drepte et luftangrep fra Burma-arméen i Doo Tha Htoo-distrikt en landsbyboer og såret fem, inkludert to barn, og ødela hus i Bilin kommune. Junta fortsetter store angrep på rohingya-sivilbefolkningen, inkludert en broødeleggelseskampanje i Arakan og fremdriften av et 108‑kilometer langt gjerde på grensen mot Bangladesh. Den innrømmet også korrupsjon i konskripsjonssystemet og startet tiltak mot nesten to hundre tjenestemenn. Det var 2 332 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: The United States signed a military cooperation agreement with Venezuela's interim government, and a U.S. marine died after falling overboard during a Caribbean operation linked to the renewed ties. Former oil minister Machado called for a more drastic overhaul of the oil sector amid hyperinflation, food shortages, massive emigration and socioeconomic collapse. Venezuelan grassroots groups rejected the agreement and denounced what they called a normalization of subordination, while military prisoners entered a third week without food and families took the fight to court. Two battle-related deaths were recorded in 2007, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: USA signerte en militær samarbeidsavtale med Venezuelas midlertidige regjering, og en amerikansk marine døde etter å ha falt overbord under en karibisk operasjon knyttet til de fornyede båndene. Den tidligere oljeministeren Machado oppfordret til en mer drastisk omlegging av oljesektoren midt i hyperinflasjon, matmangel, massiv emigrasjon og sosialøkonomisk kollaps. Venezuelas grasrotgrupper avviste avtalen og fordømte det de kalte en normalisering av underordning, mens militærfanger gikk inn i en tredje uke uten mat og familier tok kampen til retten.
